metadata.title: That 1 kill where I literally just stood there and Valorant said ‘Here, have it’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, I swear I wasn’t even aiming!
Enemy must’ve been playing hide-and-seek... and lost.
Click if your kills come from pure confusion and chaos.
Valorant logic is officially broken again.

Tap if your kills are pure accident magic!
